sloka: तामापतन्तीं भरतानुजोग्रैर्जघान बाणैश्च हुताग्निकल्पैः ।तथापि सा तस्य विवेश शक्तिर्बाह्वन्तरं दाशरथेर्विशालम् ।। ६.५९.१०९ ।।।।
transliteration: tāmāpatantīṁ bharatānujograirjaghāna bāṇaiśca hutāgnikalpaiḥ ।tathāpi sā tasya viveśa śaktirbāhvantaraṁ dāśaratherviśālam ।। 6.59.109 ।।।।

translations.english: The Lord of the world of Rakshasas instantly flung javelin, emitting fire without smoke, on Saumithri, which created fear among Vanaras.
